# ThriveStart

## About
ThriveStart, founded by Carter Henderson, does two things: (1) buy-side M&A advisory that gets first-time independent sponsors and search fund operators from LOI to close and through the first 100 days, and (2) AI-driven finance automation plus senior CFO advisory for established $10M+ businesses that have never had a real finance team.

## Primary pages
- For independent sponsors: https://thrivestart.co/independent-sponsors/
- For business owners: https://thrivestart.co/business-owners/
- About Carter Henderson: https://thrivestart.co/about/

## Services

### CFO Services ($3,500/month)
Senior-level CFO support including 13-week rolling cash flow forecasts, KPI dashboards, financial modeling, margin optimization, AR/AP management, and board/lender reporting.
URL: https://thrivestart.co/services/cfo-services/

### M&A Advisory ($5,000/month)
Buy-side and sell-side transaction support from target identification through integration, including LOI drafting, diligence management, and deal structuring.
URL: https://thrivestart.co/services/ma-advisory/

### Capital Advisory ($5,000/month)
Lender/investor mapping, underwriting model and lender deck creation, outreach pipeline management, and term sheet negotiation.
URL: https://thrivestart.co/services/capital-advisory/

### Financial Due Diligence
Quality of earnings analysis, working capital assessment, and financial risk identification for acquisition decisions.
URL: https://thrivestart.co/services/financial-due-diligence/

### Financial Workouts
Crisis stabilization with 13-week cash flow management, vendor and creditor negotiations, and turnaround planning.
URL: https://thrivestart.co/services/financial-workouts/

### Deal Structuring
Equity splits, seller notes, earnouts, working capital pegs, reps and escrows modeled for cash and downside.
URL: https://thrivestart.co/services/deal-structuring/

### SBA Distressed Situations
SBA loan default resolution, offer-in-compromise negotiations, Treasury referral defense, and guarantor liability management.
URL: https://thrivestart.co/services/sba-distressed/

### AI Financial Implementation
AI tool selection and integration for finance teams, including automated workflows and AI-assisted forecasting.
URL: https://thrivestart.co/services/ai-financial-implementation/

## Target Audience
- Independent sponsors and search fund operators
- PE-backed portfolio companies and roll-up platforms
- Growth-stage founders raising capital ($2M-$10M ARR)
- Distressed business owners (SBA loan defaults, cash crises)
- Family businesses professionalizing finance

## Differentiators
- M&A and deal execution depth (unique vs bookkeeping-focused competitors)
- Crisis and distressed finance capabilities (SBA workouts, turnarounds)
- Transparent per-service pricing ($3,500-$5,000/month)
- Explicit focus on independent sponsors and PE-backed companies
